verses.ar: «هَذَا كُلُّهُ رَأَتْهُ عَيْنِي. سَمِعَتْهُ أُذُنِي وَفَطِنَتْ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: Lo, mine eye hath seen all [this], mine ear hath heard and understood it.
verses.web: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

verses.ar: مَا تَعْرِفُونَهُ عَرَفْتُهُ أَنَا أَيْضًا. لَسْتُ دُونَكُمْ.
verses.kjv: What ye know, [the same] do I know also: I [am] not inferior unto you.
verses.web: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

verses.ar: وَلَكِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْقَدِيرَ، وَأَنْ أُحَاكَمَ إِلَى ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
verses.web: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنْتُمْ فَمُلَفِّقُو كَذِبٍ. أَطِبَّاءُ بَطَّالُونَ كُلُّكُمْ.
verses.kjv: But ye [are] forgers of lies, ye [are] all physicians of no value.
verses.web: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

verses.ar: لَيْتَكُمْ تَصْمُتُونَ صَمْتًا. يَكُونُ ذَلِكَ لَكُمْ حِكْمَةً.
verses.kjv: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
verses.web: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

verses.ar: اِسْمَعُوا ٱلْآنَ حُجَّتِي، وَٱصْغُوا إِلَى دَعَاوِي شَفَتَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.web: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

verses.ar: أَتَقُولُونَ لِأَجْلِ ٱللهِ ظُلْمًا، وَتَتَكَلَّمُونَ بِغِشٍّ لِأَجْلِهِ؟
verses.kjv: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
verses.web: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

verses.ar: أَتُحَابُونَ وَجْهَهُ، أَمْ عَنِ ٱللهِ تُخَاصِمُونَ؟
verses.kjv: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
verses.web: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

verses.ar: أَخَيْرٌ لَكُمْ أَنْ يَفْحَصَكُمْ، أَمْ تُخَاتِلُونَهُ كَمَا يُخَاتَلُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ؟
verses.kjv: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye [so] mock him?
verses.web: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

verses.ar: تَوْبِيخًا يُوَبِّخُكُمْ إِنْ حَابَيْتُمُ ٱلْوُجُوهَ خِفْيَةً.
verses.kjv: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
verses.web: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

verses.ar: فَهَلَّا يُرْهِبُكُمْ جَلَالُهُ، وَيَسْقُطُ عَلَيْكُمْ رُعْبُهُ؟
verses.kjv: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
verses.web: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

verses.ar: خُطَبُكُمْ أَمْثَالُ رَمَادٍ، وَحُصُونُكُمْ حُصُونٌ مِنْ طِينٍ.
verses.kjv: Your remembrances [are] like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
verses.web: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

verses.ar: «اُسْكُتُوا عَنِّي فَأَتَكَلَّمَ أَنَا، وَلْيُصِبْنِي مَهْمَا أَصَابَ.
verses.kjv: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what [will].
verses.web: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا آخُذُ لَحْمِي بِأَسْنَانِي، وَأَضَعُ نَفْسِي فِي كَفِّي؟
verses.kjv: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
verses.web: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

verses.ar: هُوَذَا يَقْتُلُنِي. لَا أَنْتَظِرُ شَيْئًا. فَقَطْ أُزَكِّي طَرِيقِي قُدَّامَهُ.
verses.kjv: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
verses.web: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

verses.ar: فَهَذَا يَعُودُ إِلَى خَلَاصِي، أَنَّ ٱلْفَاجِرَ لَا يَأْتِي قُدَّامَهُ.
verses.kjv: He also [shall be] my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
verses.web: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

verses.ar: سَمْعًا ٱسْمَعُوا أَقْوَالِي وَتَصْرِيحِي بِمَسَامِعِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
verses.web: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

verses.ar: هَأَنَذَا قَدْ أَحْسَنْتُ ٱلدَّعْوَى. أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي أَتَبَرَّرُ.
verses.kjv: Behold now, I have ordered [my] cause; I know that I shall be justified.
verses.web: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

verses.ar: مَنْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُخَاصِمُنِي حَتَّى أَصْمُتَ ٱلْآنَ وَأُسْلِمَ ٱلرُّوحَ؟
verses.kjv: Who [is] he [that] will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
verses.web: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا أَمْرَيْنِ لَا تَفْعَلْ بِي، فَحِينَئِذٍ لَا أَخْتَفِي مِنْ حَضْرَتِكَ.
verses.kjv: Only do not two [things] unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
verses.web: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

verses.ar: أَبْعِدْ يَدَيْكَ عَنِّي، وَلَا تَدَعْ هَيْبَتَكَ تُرْعِبُنِي.
verses.kjv: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
verses.web: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱدْعُ فَأَنَا أُجِيبُ، أَوْ أَتَكَلَّمُ فَتُجَاوِبُنِي.
verses.kjv: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
verses.web: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

verses.ar: كَمْ لِي مِنَ ٱلْآثَامِ وَٱلْخَطَايَا؟ أَعْلِمْنِي ذَنْبِي وَخَطِيَّتِي.
verses.kjv: How many [are] mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.web: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا تَحْجُبُ وَجْهَكَ، وَتَحْسِبُنِي عَدُوًّا لَكَ؟
verses.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
verses.web: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

verses.ar: أَتُرْعِبُ وَرَقَةً مُنْدَفَعَةً، وَتُطَارِدُ قَشًّا يَابِسًا؟
verses.kjv: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
verses.web: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ كَتَبْتَ عَلَيَّ أُمُورًا مُرَّةً، وَوَرَّثْتَنِي آثَامَ صِبَايَ،
verses.kjv: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
verses.web: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

verses.ar: فَجَعَلْتَ رِجْلَيَّ فِي ٱلْمِقْطَرَةِ، وَلَاحَظْتَ جَمِيعَ مَسَالِكِي، وَعَلَى أُصُولِ رِجْلَيَّ نَبَشْتَ.
verses.kjv: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
verses.web: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

verses.ar: وَأَنَا كَمُتَسَوِّسٍ يَبْلَى، كَثَوْبٍ أَكَلَهُ ٱلْعُثُّ.
verses.kjv: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
verses.web: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
